description: LoRA target policy, rank and the optimisation constants 00 §8.3 requires to be hashed.

fallback_target_policy.note: 01 §8B fallback, used only on a recorded architecture-compatibility failure.

adapter_scaling.note: 00 §8.3 lists scaling among the values that must be fixed across seeds and hashed; not numerically specified.

gradient_accumulation_steps.note: 00 §8.3 requires the effective batch construction to be fixed across seeds; the value depends on the H100 memory profile and is frozen before S06 training.

sequence_length.note: Training sequence length. Must agree with the scoring max_sequence_length the backend reports [AUTH: 02 §C6, §C7].

gradient_clipping_norm.note: 00 §8.3 clipping for the NON_DP arm. The DP arm's per-sample clipping norm is a separate constant in training/dp.json and is not a substitute.

data_order_policy.note: 01 §30: mini-batch order is driven by the recorded data_order seed family, never by a global RNG.

checkpoint_policy.note: 01 §29 / 00 §34B.1A: selecting a checkpoint by looking at an outcome is result-driven tuning; only the final adapter at the declared step count is kept.

fixture_sequence_length.note: Reference trainer over the tiny fixture only; matches the S03 scoring fixture length.

optimizer.note: 00 §8.3 optimizer. Frozen before S06 training, against the real model.

learning_rate.note: 00 §8.3 learning rate. Frozen before S06 training.

epochs.note: 00 §8.3 number of epochs/steps. Frozen before S06 training.

batch_size.note: 00 §8.3 batch size. Frozen before S06 training.

precision.note: 01 §16 records precision; the value is bound to the resolved H100 image and is not chosen here.

fixture_learning_rate.note: Reference trainer over the tiny fixture only. Not a research hyperparameter.

fixture_epochs.note: Reference trainer over the tiny fixture only.

fixture_batch_size.note: Reference trainer over the tiny fixture only.

member_subset_seed_offset.note: 00 §6.3: the member-subset RNG seed is derived from the training seed, not chosen independently.
